To integrate a vector-valued function, we integrate each component separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /4}⟨\frac{{csc}^{2}⁡t}{1-\operatorname{cot}⁡t},\,2\operatorname{cos}⁡t⟩\,\text{d}t & =⟨{\int }_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /4}\frac{{csc}^{2}⁡t}{1-\operatorname{cot}⁡t}\,\text{d}t,{\int }_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /4}2\operatorname{cos}⁡t\,\text{d}t⟩ \\  & =⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-\operatorname{cot}⁡t){|}_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /4},\,2\operatorname{sin}⁡t{|}_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /4}⟩ \\  & =⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-\operatorname{cot}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{4}))-\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-\operatorname{cot}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})),\,2\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{4})-2\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})⟩ \\  & =⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡2-\operatorname{ln}⁡1,\,\sqrt{2}-2⟩ \\  & =⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡2,\,\sqrt{2}-2⟩\end{aligned}
$$
